_readme: Card #1572 sweep. investigatedVerdicts below records the manual live-page verification for every STRONG (theatre-record-month, before_preview) candidate found on the 2026-08-16 run, before this file's regeneration removed the corrected ones from the strong[] list. See broadway-review-texts commit bf2bd6886d4 for the 3 files corrected (2 misparse incidents: cats-west-end-2026 x2 sharing one URL, hadestown-west-end-2024 x1).

investigatedVerdicts.detail: publishDate 2025-07-14 was a misparse. Guardian URL /2026/aug/07/ + web search confirm the review is part of the Aug 2026 Regent's Park Cats coverage. Corrected to 2026-08-07, wrongProduction cleared with full manual-clear field set. broadway-review-texts bf2bd6886d4.

Same underlying Guardian URL as arifa-akbar.json (a stale duplicate-of-record with its own bad date, 'April 7, 2026'). Corrected to 2026-08-07 for consistency, wrongProduction cleared. Not found by the automated sweep (only 1 corroboration signal search per show/file is run, and this file's duplicateOf relationship isn't scanned) — found by manually inspecting the duplicateOf pointer on the arifa-akbar hit. broadway-review-texts bf2bd6886d4.

publishDate 2023-02-22 was a misparse (year off by one). TheReviewsHub live page (thereviewshub.com/hadestown-lyric-theatre-london) confirms 'February 22, 2024', matching Theatre Record's 2024/2 archive month and the show's 2024-02-10 opening. Corrected to 2024-02-22, wrongProduction cleared. broadway-review-texts bf2bd6886d4.

The stored url is https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/theatre/richard-ii-bridge-theatre-review-jonathan-bailey-... — a Richard II review at the Bridge Theatre, not The Tempest. The theatreRecordUrl (2026/1/37280-the-tempest) is a mis-attached cross-reference, not real corroboration. Correctly flagged wrong-content; left as-is. Demonstrates the sweep's theatre-record-month signal can itself be wrong and every hit needs live-page/content verification, not just date math.

CORRECTED 2026-08-17 after ship-check caught the original verdict here was wrong: this is NOT a grace-window-sizing question. Reading fullText directly (everything-theatre--sara-west.json) confirms these are reviews of a National Youth Music Theatre AMATEUR production at Southwark Playhouse ('Was it wise then, to choose to go to an amateur production of the same?... This production was courtesy of the National Youth Music Theatre'), not the professional Groff/Radcliffe/Mendez Broadway revival (merrily-we-roll-along-2023, category:broadway). Correctly flagged wrongProduction on content grounds; the near-matching dates and theatre-record-month signal are coincidental — Theatre Record's archive apparently cross-references multiple unrelated productions sharing this title around the same period. Left flagged. Demonstrates the theatre-record-month signal needs a same-production check (venue/cast/category), not just same-month, to avoid this class of false corroboration in a future sweep.

after_close date-guard flag with a theatre-record-month match — deliberately excluded from the strong-signal sweep because an after_close TR-month match is more likely a successor production mislinked back than a misparse (wrong-production-corroboration.js header comment). Left flagged.
